name: Southern Cross
source:
In 1999 main character stays at the Southern Cross star. He has already retrieved the Phoenix capsule, and now looks for a way to return to the Earth. He is suddenly told about an opportunity to ride a UFO as soon as he finds the secret password in his room.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
1999年，主人公身处南十字星。他已经拿到了不死鸟胶囊，正在寻找返回地球的方法。这时，有人突然告诉他，只要找到藏在自己房间里的秘密口令，就有机会搭乘飞碟。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
